paper.title_en: A Singularity Theorem for Quasi-Topological Gravities
paper.abstract_en: Quasi-topological theories of gravity have recently attracted substantial attention as several theories in this class have a non-singular black hole as a vacuum and spherically symmetric solution. This motivates the expectation that these theories can provide a resolution to the singularity problem and a description of black holes cores. The known solutions, however, possess a Cauchy horizon which denotes the end of predictability of the theory, as the initial data do not determine a unique continuation past this type of horizon. In this paper, we show that Penrose singularity theorem can be extended to all the known classes of quasi-topological theories that have non-singular black holes as solutions. We prove that spherical collapse satisfying the null energy condition necessarily leads to future null geodesic incompleteness once a trapped sphere forms. This implies that the lack of predictability of the theories is not an artefact of vacuum solutions and these theories are as problematic as general relativity for the dynamical studies of black hole interiors.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文将Penrose奇点定理推广到已知各类准拓扑引力理论，直接讨论非奇异黑洞解与Cauchy视界导致的预言性失效问题，属于广义相对论基础与黑洞内部结构研究的核心议题，理论深度突出，对关注奇点定理与黑洞内部动力学的研究者有明确阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 准拓扑引力的一个奇点定理
decision.abstract_zh: 准拓扑引力理论近来受到大量关注，因为这一类理论中有若干理论以非奇异黑洞作为真空且球对称的解。这激发了一种期望：这些理论能够为奇点问题提供解决方案，并描述黑洞核心。然而，已知的解具有Cauchy视界，该视界标志着理论可预言性的终点，因为初始数据无法决定跨越这类视界的唯一延拓。在本文中，我们证明Penrose奇点定理可以推广到所有以非奇异黑洞为解的已知准拓扑理论类别。我们证明：满足零能量条件的球对称坍缩，一旦形成囚陷球面，就必然导致未来零测地线不完备。这意味着这些理论的可预言性缺失并非真空解的假象，并且在对黑洞内部的动力学研究中，这些理论与广义相对论一样存在问题。
